# JS registry categories in Odoo 20

`registry.category(name).add(key, value)` call sites found in `static/src` and `static/tests` of every addon (`services (plugins)` lists `services.add(PluginClass)` from `@web/core/services`). Query one category with `odoo_js(registry="<name>")`.
